criteria_note: Criteria scored: A-F, G, X1, R1-R3 (review). Prose length counts body text without front matter, headings, display math, tables, code and the References block. Claims were checked against the arXiv HTML (sections 1-5 and Tables 1-3). Neither post names the experiment models (BGE-m3 for embedding and reranking, gpt-4o-mini for graph construction) or the DMR dataset size (500 conversations, 5 sessions, up to 12 messages per session), so R1 is lower for both.

A.reason: Clear arc (problem, 3-tier graph, update, communities, retrieval, DMR, LME, per-type, limitations) and valid Markdown. Deductions: the heading on L261 reads like a sentence ('질문 유형별로 엇갈리는 이득: 복잡한 추론은 크게 오르고 단일 세션 어시스턴트 질문은 하락'); generic duplicated H3s '평가 설정' (L209, L238) and '결과' (L244) are not claim headings.

B.reason: Natural 입니다 register throughout. Deductions: L38 '다만 문서 내용이 거의 바뀌지 않는다고 가정하는 검색이라면' uses '다만' with no contrast (rewrite: '그런데 문서가 거의 바뀌지 않는다고 가정하는 검색에는'); L42 '결국 Zep이 바꾸려는 것은 두 가지입니다' is formulaic; L94 is one overlong sentence that re-explains the example in parentheses ('앞선 섹션의 요금제 예(첫 세션에서는 ... 가상의 상황)에서는 ...'); L147 '가상으로, 두 번째 세션에서' is awkward; L189-190 table cells '기존 방식' say nothing.

C.reason: Concepts come before use, and the running example threads through. Deductions: the motivation is restated inside the method sections (L56 '이 설계는 저자들이 내세운 문제의식과 맞닿아 있습니다. 기존 RAG가 ...', L62 last sentence about Graphiti repeats L38, L78 repeats L42's production-scalability and DMR/LME paragraph almost verbatim), which breaks the flow.

D.reason: Hard parts get help at the right time: the bitemporal table plus the dated plan example (L121, the 5/20 vs 5/13 gap), the plurality vote example (L147), and the hop-count notation note (L179). Slight over-explaining in L52's φ* aside.

E.reason: Tables fit their content (tiers L70, timestamps L114, rerankers L187, Tables 1-3 copied cell for cell). The equations are relevant. Deductions: the reranker table cells L189-190 '기존 방식' carry no information; L141-143 adds a self-written argmax formula (labelled as a restatement, which is fine).

F.reason: All checked numbers match Tables 1-3 and the text. No invented results. Minor: L52 reads φ* as an inverse image and L179 reads the superscript n as list length; both are the writer's interpretations of notation the paper leaves undefined, and both are labelled as such. The 15.2% gpt-4o-mini relative gain the paper states is omitted (L253).

G.reason: use_math true with $$ only and no \( \). Description is exactly 120 chars (lower bound), starts with 'Zep', and uses only TL;DR/abstract numbers (94.8, 18.5, 90). Prompt tokens (<FACTS>) are in backticks (L199). No | inside math on table rows.

X1.reason: The category is a blog topic. Tags mostly use the paper's terms (Temporal-Knowledge-Graph, Edge-Invalidation, Bi-Temporal-Model), but 'Graph-Based-Retrieval' is generic and 7 tags is on the high side.

R1.reason: Covers construction, temporal extraction, invalidation, communities, the retrieval formalism, all three tables and the MemGPT exclusion. Misses the models (BGE-m3, gpt-4o-mini for construction), the 500-conversation DMR size, the bidirectional episode indices, and the 15.2% figure.

R2.reason: Intuition, then formalism, then the running example, in every method section (e.g. L102-127). Length matches a moderately simple systems paper; some padding from the repeated motivation.

R3.reason: The TL;DR answers all four questions with numbers in their setting (L28 gpt-4-turbo 94.8 vs 93.4; L29 against the full-context baseline). The closing names specific gaps (DMR-only SOTA, MemGPT absent from LME, latency confound, write-path LLM cost, no benchmark for business data) with a reasoned own view (L294). TL;DR L29 does not say the 18.5% is relative or for gpt-4o.

claim_headings.evidence: Most H2s are claims (L82 '엔티티 해소와 이중시간 엣지 무효화로 이뤄지는 손실 없는 갱신', L205); the H3s '평가 설정' (L209, L238) and '결과' (L244) are generic.

running_example.evidence: The basic-to-premium plan example runs from L38 through extraction (L94), timestamps (L121), invalidation (L127), communities (L147), search (L181), the constructor (L201), LME (L257) and the closing (L296).

mechanism_reason_formula_example.evidence: Bitemporal: mechanism L104, reason L112, formula L108, worked example L121. Label propagation: reason L139, rule L141-145, example L147.

facts_said_once.evidence: The static-RAG and production-scalability motivation appears in L17, L36, L42, L56 and L78; the Graphiti non-lossy sentence appears in L20, L38 and L62.

numbers_with_variant_scope_unit.evidence: Tables carry the model per row. L29 'TL;DR 최대 18.5%' does not name gpt-4o or the relative basis (L253 does); L207 '1%p 남짓' is scoped correctly.

nothing_invented.evidence: Hypothetical examples are labelled '가상의' (L38, L100, L121); the self-written formula is labelled (L141).

own_assessment_at_end.evidence: L294 '이 글은 두 번째 빈틈이 결론을 흔들지는 않는다고 봅니다 ... 보수적인 추정' and L296's practical guidance.

length_fitted.evidence: About 16.7k prose chars is reasonable for this paper, but the repeated motivation paragraphs (L56, L78) are padding.

type_specific_shape.evidence: Four-question TL;DR, a method walkthrough, results tables, and a limitations section.

korean_style.evidence: Natural overall; formulaic '결국 ...두 가지입니다' (L42), a misused '다만' (L38), the overlong L94.

A.reason: Clear arc and valid Markdown. Deductions: a writing-process term leaks into the body, L288 'running example에 대입해 보면'; L89's subsection '원본을 지우지 않는 갱신' is a recap with no new content; standalone wrap-up lines L300 and L335 restate their sections.

B.reason: Mostly natural 입니다 register. Deductions: L288 'running example에 대입해 보면' (rewrite: '앞의 고객 지원 예에 대입해 보면'); the constructor χ is translated as '생성기' (L26, L186, L196), which suggests text generation (rewrite: '구성기'); L286 'Zep이 LLM에 넘긴 컨텍스트는 평균 1.6k 토큰으로, 전체 컨텍스트 기준은 115k 토큰이었습니다' is a clumsy join; L350 '이 글은 다음과 같이 봅니다.' is formulaic.

C.reason: Good forward and backward references (L116, L232). Deductions: L286's last sentence '앞서 본 검색·리랭커·생성기의 합성이 질의를 LLM용 컨텍스트 문자열로 바꾸는 단계입니다.' is a non-sequitur; L89 and L304 ('앞서 본 전체 정확도 향상도 유형별로 나눠 보면 이렇게 고르지 않습니다') repeat themselves; the motivation is restated at L39, L43 and L89.

D.reason: Well-timed help: the two-timeline intuition (L99 '2주 전에 이직했어요'), the dated invalidation worked example with interval [3/1, 3/20) (L122), why a context window is needed (L136), and why cosine plus full text (L142). The general Leiden background is labelled as outside the paper (L166).

E.reason: Tables fit (tier table with index sets L63, timestamps L103, rerankers L218, Tables 1-3 copied cell for cell); the plurality formula uses \lvert\rvert correctly (L172). Minor: the reranker cells for RRF/MMR (L220-221) are the writer's glosses, not the paper's, though they are correct.

F.reason: All table numbers match. Deduction: L298 attributes the 'more capable models' interpretation to Table 2 ('저자들도 이 표를 두고, 더 강한 모델과 짝지었을 때 개선이 가장 두드러진다고 해석'), but the paper draws it from the per-type knowledge-update result and Table 3 (4.3.2). L284 '이 값은 기준 정확도 대비 상대 향상입니다' asserts the basis although 71.2/60.2 computes to ~18.3%.

G.reason: use_math true with $$ only and no \( \). Description is 132 chars, starts with 'Zep', and uses only TL;DR numbers. Template tokens are written as plain FACTS/ENTITIES (L230), so there is no raw prompt token.

X1.reason: Paper-term tags (Edge-Invalidation, Community-Subgraph, Bi-Temporal-Modeling) plus controlled Knowledge-Graph and Agentic-AI; 7 tags is on the high side and 'Bi-Temporal-Modeling' is not the paper's 'bi-temporal model'.

R1.reason: Covers T' as auditing and T as event time (L99), the 15.2% and 18.5% figures, latency IQR (L294), the MemGPT exclusion in the setup (L271), the 4-of-6 categories (L31, L331) and the community-name retrieval. Misses BGE-m3, the construction model, the DMR size and the bidirectional indices.

R2.reason: Intuition, then formalism, then worked example (L97-126); the pipeline section explains each guard before the example. Length is appropriate, with some recap padding.

R3.reason: The TL;DR is concrete and scoped (L29 the 60-message caveat; L30 '(상대 향상)' against the full-context baseline; L31 four of six categories). The closing separates the authors' limitations (L343-346) from the writer's judgment (L350-356); the speculative cause is labelled '추정합니다' (L352).

preference.reason: Close call. Y has more complete results reporting (both 15.2% and 18.5% scoped as relative, IQR, 4 of 6 categories) and a cleaner limitations section that separates the authors' view from the writer's. X reads as a more polished publishable post: it has no meta-term leak, no orphan sentence and no constructor mistranslation, and it ties the 'more capable models' remark correctly to knowledge-update, where Y misplaces it. X's main weaknesses are repeated motivation paragraphs and the missing 15.2%. On balance X is marginally preferred.
